core.title: Door Lock Installation Kit, DEW D180004

text.description_html:
DeWalt D180004 Door Lock Installation Kit

This door lock installation boring kit made by DeWalt is used to drill accurately placed installation holes for levers, knobs, deadbolts, and handlesets. The included hole saws are for use on wood, metal, or fiberglass doors. The kit includes both 2-1/8” diameter hole saw for the face bore and a 1” diameter hole saw for the latch. The jig is adjustable to accommodate either 2-3/8” or 2-3/4” backsets on a standard 1-3/8 or 1-3/4” thick door. The jig incorporates a height alignment window and taller bushings so even the novice can bore a perfectly straight hole. This door lock iInstallation kit utilizes a padded C-clamp design that firmly attaches to the door without damaging the surface. The 4 piece kit includes: 2-1/8" hole saw, pilot hole drill bit, drill guide, adapter, 1" hole saw.

Specifications of the DEW D180004:

  • Overall Height: 4-1/4"
  • Overall Width: 6-1/2"
  • Overall Depth: 6"
  • Bit Material: Steel
  • Hole Saw Material: Steel
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" or 1-3/4
  • Door Material: Wood, Metal, Fiberglass
  • Includes: 2-1/8" hole saw, pilot hole drill bit, drill guide, adapter, 1" hole saw
